target: projects/etc-message-generator/index.html — PIMS Meldung bearbeiten, ELA generator

resolved.title: Prompt field collapsed to zero height after switching Quelle away from Standard and back
resolved.fix: Source blocks are toggled before any auto-sizing, and growOne() refuses to size an element with no layout.
resolved.verified_by: verify.js — prompt visible after library → standard → voice → standard

resolved.title: Sheet close button fell back to Arial instead of Roboto
Library and recording pickers reset to '— bitte wählen —' after a pick, so nothing said which entry was loaded
resolved.fix: Both option lists now emit `selected` for the loaded entry, and the state line names it: 'Aus Bibliothek · Aufzug außer Betrieb'.
resolved.verified_by: verify.js — picker keeps the chosen entry selected; state line names the loaded library entry / recording

resolved.title: Text generation had no progress feedback and left GENERATE ELA enabled, while the audio render right below it showed a progress bar (KF-1 rage-click path)
resolved.fix: The button goes disabled and reads GENERIERT … during a generation, with the same determinate progress bar the audio render uses.
resolved.verified_by: verify.js — generate button disabled while generating; progress bar visible; usable again afterwards

resolved.title: The pre-save line showed only the first matching warning, so the DAISY length notice hid 'the audio does not match the text'
resolved.fix: The save area lists every active warning, ordered by consequence: stale audio → event changed → no audio → DAISY truncation → not listened.
resolved.verified_by: verify.js — stale audio still shown alongside the DAISY length warning, and listed before it

resolved.title: The pre-save line read green 'Bereit zum Speichern' while both message boxes were flagged 'Ereignis geändert'
resolved.fix: 'Ereignis geändert' is now one of the pre-save warnings.
resolved.verified_by: verify.js — event change reaches the pre-save area

resolved.title: Typing one character into EN cleared the DE/EN divergence warning with no check that the two languages still matched
resolved.fix: An EN hand-edit clears 'Übersetzung nicht aktuell' but raises 'DE/EN nicht abgeglichen', which only clears on a regenerate.
resolved.verified_by: verify.js — editing EN does not clear the divergence signal; regenerating does

resolved.title: SPEICHERN answered with a bare 'Meldung gespeichert.' in every unsafe state, contradicting the warning shown a moment earlier
resolved.fix: The toast now names the warning it saved under: 'Gespeichert — mit Warnung: …', or 'Gespeichert — DE + EN mit aktuellem Audio (0:27)'. Save is still never blocked, per the dispatcher-alone decision.
resolved.verified_by: verify.js — save toast names the warning instead of claiming success

resolved.title: Generation and audio failures were a caption with no retry
resolved.fix: Both error state lines carry an inline 'Wiederholen' action.
resolved.verified_by: verify.js — failure line offers an inline retry

resolved.title: The waveform read as a scrubber but was decorative, and nothing showed playback position
resolved.fix: Waveform is pointer-events:none and dimmed so it reads as a graphic; the state line shows 'läuft 0:07 / 0:20' during playback.
resolved.verified_by: verify.js — playback shows an elapsed position, not just a label flip

resolved.title: 'angehört' was set the instant ANHÖREN was pressed, so the pre-save 'has anyone listened?' check was satisfied by a click
resolved.fix: listened is set in endPlay() — only when the file has run to the end. Stopping early leaves the warning in place.
resolved.verified_by: verify.js — pressing play alone does not satisfy the listened check; it lands once playback reaches the end

resolved.title: A focused message box was skipped by render(), so the visible text could differ from the stored text after a library/recording pick
resolved.fix: onLibrary/onRec write both textareas directly instead of relying on render().
resolved.note: Two passes rated this Critical. Independently checked: a real mouse click on the picker moves focus off the textarea first, so it was reachable only by a programmatic change (as the recon script did). Fixed anyway; severity corrected in the report.
resolved.verified_by: browser check — focus moves from ta-de to #source on a real click

resolved.title: Abbrechen and Speichern should be sticky and always visible
resolved.fix: The sheet is a flex column: only the body scrolls, and a pinned footer holds the pre-save warnings plus Abbrechen/Speichern.
resolved.verified_by: verify.js — save footer pinned to the bottom of the sheet and stays put when the body is scrolled

not_fixed.title: No way to step back to a previous variant after re-clicking GENERATE ELA
not_fixed.why: Ignat removed the history button in the previous round. Adding a variant stepper would re-introduce that control. Needs his decision.

not_fixed.why: By customer request DAISY is predefined and only ELA is playful. Flagged to Ignat as a question for the customer rather than fixed.
